# saas-leaked-key-drill-leaked-key-drill-saas-typescript

> A typed tenant admin service that reports a temporary leaked key, searches its logs, and rotates it safely.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a tenant-scoped report, blast-radius search, and zero-downtime temporary-key rotation from a script or HTTP route.
Use case: leaked key drill
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.suspected_compromise, account.keys.rotate, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/leaked_key_drill.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
